gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (170 SMs), driver 595.71.05, CUDA 13.0
build: Release, CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 (compute_80 PTX, JIT) unless stated

best_pipeline.settings: JHQ_PRIMARY_GROUPS=-1 JHQ_SHARED_BOUND=1 JHQ_REFINE_LANES=16; calibrate_schedule once per index
best_pipeline.recall: identical (0 non-tie differences; final id sets identical in 234320 query comparisons)

experiments.name: baseline audit and profiling; native sm_120
experiments.decision: primary screening is the bottleneck (61-85% of latency); small batch lacks parallelism; sm_120 reported separately, not adopted

experiments.name: v62 list-parallel primary screening
experiments.correctness: 64/64 comparisons NON-TIE 0, final bit-identical, sanitizers clean

experiments.name: budget-aware selection: quota pilot
experiments.evidence: group 0 holds 46-81% of the global top-ck at G=8; equal quotas certify 0-67%; calibrated quotas >=99% but critical-path group cannot shrink; bound <= ~4% e2e at b=8

experiments.name: budget-aware selection: v63 exact shared bound
experiments.correctness: 48/48 identical to v62 (top-ck and final), NON-TIE 0 vs v61, memcheck/racecheck/synccheck clean

experiments.name: v64 routing by Pi^T c
experiments.correctness: NON-TIE 0 on same-probe queries; final top-k and recall identical; probe sets differ for 1-8% (768-d) and 40% (openai3) of queries

experiments.name: v65 adaptive execution schedule
experiments.rule: G=max(fill, skew); fill: largest G with B*G*BLOCK <= 0.6*SMs*maxThreadsPerSM; skew: 4 if per-query candidate CV >= 0.3 (512 base-vector pseudo-queries) else 1; G=1 -> v61 scan

experiments.name: v66 stage-aware data layout
experiments.reason: no layout bottleneck: large-batch scan streams codes at 1.34-1.64 TB/s no-reuse demand vs 1.79 TB/s peak with coalesced word layout; small batch is parallelism-bound; counters unavailable (ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM)

experiments.name: v67 selective kernel fusion
experiments.reason: GPU idle inside the graph 0.4-3.4 us per search; kernel boundary gaps 0.06-0.13 us; intermediate traffic ck floats per query

experiments.name: final integration and full benchmark
experiments.configs: 6 datasets x np 128/512 at sampled-rule alpha (+arxiv/128 alpha 200), b 8/32/256/1000, 5 paired rounds; frontier alpha x1/2 and x2
